text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Miles, great work tonight. You had the inbound pass, the no-look pass to Devin Booker. Just walk me through how that unfolded.

text_blocks.speaker: Miles Bridges
text_blocks.text: We made eye contact. He seen Josh Green was playing him up, so should get an easy layup right there. I was nervous on the pass though, but I got it there.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on his rebounding and physicality
quotes.excerpt: We play against bigs that are strong every day, so we got to help our bigs out.
quotes.quote: Just boxing guys out and then going on the offensive end. Just trying to get as much as I can, you know, trying to help out. We play against bigs that are strong every day, so we got to help our bigs out, and that's what we've been doing.
quotes.social_post: Miles Bridges on his rebounding effort: We play against bigs that are strong every day, so we got to help our bigs out, and that is what we have been doing.

structured.context: Miles Bridges explains his approach to rebounding and helping the team's big men during a postgame interview.

quotes.speaker: Miles Bridges
quotes.summary_phrase: Miles Bridges on maintaining the Suns' winning momentum
quotes.excerpt: When we play like a defensive team, our offense is going to come.
quotes.quote: Keep the vibes high. Keep the streak going and put defense first. When we play like a defensive team, our offense is going to come, so we just got to keep the vibes high.
